It produces customized mouse models, such as knockout (KO) and knockin (KI) mouse models; customized rat models, including constitutive and conditional KO, point mutation KI, and quick KI rat models; and customized cell lines, such as constitutive KO, point mutation KI, reporter KI, quick KI, and KI cell lines.
